pecorino-tenero-3-mesi: Monte Gonare is a fresh pecorino made from sheep's milk, calf rennet and salt.
Cooperativa Agricola “Unione Pastori di Sarule”, Loc. Incoreo, 08020 Sarule (NU), Sardinia.
Sheep's milk, calf rennet and salt.
Wheels are about 2.5 to 3 kg. Sold here as a 250 g wedge.
pecorino-semistagionato-8-mesi: Su Furreddu, semi-aged mixed-milk cheese. It is a formaggio misto, not a sheep's-milk pecorino.
Caseus S.r.l., Regione Mesu 'e Jagas, Thiesi (SS), Sardinia.
Sold here as a 250 g piece.
pecorino-stagionato-10-mesi: San Platano is an aged sheep's-milk cheese with an intense, enveloping aroma. On the palate it is full, savoury and persistent, in the Sardinian cheesemaking tradition. Ageing gives it a decisive but balanced character, for anyone who likes clear, recognisable flavours tied to the land.
At least 120 days (about 4 months). Sold here as a 250 g wedge.
Sheep's milk, rennet, salt and native cultures.
The rind is not edible. It is treated with extra virgin olive oil and vinegar.
